scope: Fresh native Chrome refusal for one strict allowlisted optional permission in real admin Settings, using an owned disposable headed profile and the existing receipt-verified side-panel harness.
source_basis: The existing isolated admin sign-in runner proves the real web-form and extension Settings Sign in path without injected sessions.
The current native harness owned profile and release receipt safeguards are reused. Its new headed option changes only Chrome launch mode; headless remains the default.
CUA documentation supports binding a macOS app by path and inspecting its accessibility tree/screenshot, but Chrome for Testing prompt visibility has not yet been observed in this profile.
acceptance: Before the request, real Settings shows admin@admin.com and the selected declared optional switch OFF; Chrome permissions.contains and getAll both show that permission absent.

The runner pauses at real admin Settings before the permission request. An independent UI operator uses CUA on the owned Chrome for Testing app to click the selected switch, record the native prompt and Deny action, then writes only the word denied to the displayed acknowledgement file to resume the runner.

After the acknowledgement, the runner requires the real Settings refusal alert, switch OFF, permissions.contains false, and getAll absence. It reloads the real side panel, reopens Settings, Account, and Advanced agent capabilities, and requires admin identity and the selected permission still OFF/absent. Its terminal status is postconditions_verified_requires_operator_evidence, never a standalone pass. Root combines the independent CUA evidence with those postconditions to adjudicate the case. The runner never mocks permissions.request, seeds grant state, or calls a Chrome permission override.
command_after_root_resource_admission: MATRX_PERMISSION_DENIAL_TARGET=tabCapture node tests/browser/isolated-permission-denial-acceptance.mjs (omit variable for pageCapture; only cookies, pageCapture, clipboardRead, tabCapture accepted)
safety: The browser profile is new and disposable; no primary Chrome profile or stored grant is touched. The runner reads only authorized test credentials at the real web login form and suppresses raw browser/auth errors. It records booleans and receipt metadata in test-results. No archive is created.
runtime_gate: Root must authorize one headed launch after fresh source peer review and resource admission. The UI operator must confirm the selected Chrome for Testing window belongs to the new owned profile before clicking Deny. If CUA cannot access that prompt or Chrome grants without prompting, leave the case UNVERIFIED and record the observed reason.
verification: Native Chrome denial: not launched under this lane
limitations: The plaintext acknowledgement is coordination only and proves no native UI observation by itself. Root must retain independent CUA screenshot or accessibility evidence of the native prompt and Deny action before marking this case passed; the runner verifies only subsequent Chrome permission state and visible product feedback.
Runtime 002 established pageCapture denial with independent native CUA evidence and runner postconditions on 0.2.64; the new reload assertion and tabCapture denial remain unverified until exercised.
